n8d22c6fc533.s: How many wildlife sanctuaries does Andhra Pradesh have as per APSES 2024-25?
n8d22c6fc533.x: APSES 2024-25 lists 13 wildlife sanctuaries, 3 national parks, 4 deer parks and 2 zoological parks.

nbe65b25293c.s: In which year was Papikonda upgraded to a National Park?
nbe65b25293c.x: Papikonda was a Reserved Forest in 1882, a Wildlife Sanctuary in 1978 and a National Park only in 2008.

n00d08261c7a.s: The mangroves of Andhra Pradesh grow mainly in the estuaries of the:
n00d08261c7a.x: AP's mangroves are in the Godavari and Krishna estuaries, protected by Coringa and Krishna WLS, not the Vamsadhara-Nagavali.

ndde6ff53b2a.s: Which of the following wildlife sanctuaries was notified earliest?
ndde6ff53b2a.x: Pulicat was notified in 1976, Coringa in 1978, Koundinya in 1990 and Kolleru in 1999.

nap-geography-11-4.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the hills of Andhra Pradesh?
o: The Seshachalam hills around Tirumala hold the Seshachalam Biosphere Reserve
The Palakonda hills mark the southern extent of Andhra Pradesh
The biosphere reserve in the Seshachalam hills is named Sri Venkateswara Biosphere Reserve
The Simhachalam hills mark the northern extent of Andhra Pradesh
nap-geography-11-4.x: AP's only biosphere reserve is named Seshachalam, not Sri Venkateswara; the other three statements are correct.

nap-geography-20-4.s: Adoni and Aluru in Andhra Pradesh are known for which soil?
nap-geography-20-4.x: Deep black soil occurs at Adoni and Aluru; alluvium is in the deltas and red soil in Rayalaseema.

n427e3100539.s: The North Coastal agro-climatic zone of Andhra Pradesh is associated with which soil?
n427e3100539.x: The North Coastal zone is typed by laterite; the Godavari zone has alluvium and the Scarce Rainfall zone red soil.

nap-geography-23-6.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the agro-climatic zones of Andhra Pradesh?
o: The North Coastal Zone includes Vizianagaram district
The High Altitude and Tribal Areas Zone covers the Eastern Ghats
The Southern Zone includes Vizianagaram district
The Godavari Zone covers the Godavari delta and adjoining areas
nap-geography-23-6.x: Vizianagaram is in the North Coastal Zone; the Southern Zone includes parts of Kadapa district.

neb66616572a.s: Chilli Red stone of Andhra Pradesh is associated with which district?
neb66616572a.x: Chilli Red stone comes from Anantapur; Kadapa is known for steatite of the Cuddapah system.

n6adaac20320.s: Which of the following refinery pairs is correctly matched?
n6adaac20320.x: HPCL's Visakhapatnam refinery is AP's main refinery; Tatipaka is an ONGC mini-refinery in Konaseema.

new.s: How many national parks does Andhra Pradesh have as per APSES 2024-25?
new.x: AP has 3 national parks (Papikonda, Sri Venkateswara and Rajiv Gandhi) along with 13 wildlife sanctuaries.

new.s: The smallest national park of Andhra Pradesh is:
new.x: Rajiv Gandhi (Rameswaram) NP, 2.30 sq km, is AP's smallest NP; Mrugavani is in Telangana.

new.s: The largest national park of Andhra Pradesh, about 1,012.90 sq km, is:
new.x: Papikonda NP (1,012.90 sq km) is AP's largest NP; Kasu Brahmananda Reddy NP is in Telangana.

new.s: The 'kanchu mekha' dwarf goat is associated with which protected area?
new.x: Kanchu mekha is found in Papikonda NP; Rameswaram NP and SV Sanctuary are the usual distractors.

new.s: Rajiv Gandhi (Rameswaram) National Park in Kadapa lies on the north bank of the:
new.x: Rajiv Gandhi NP (Rameswaram) lies on the north bank of the Penna in Kadapa district.

new.s: Sri Venkateswara National Park was notified in:
new.x: Sri Venkateswara NP was notified in 1989 and lies inside the larger SV Wildlife Sanctuary.

new.s: Koundinya Wildlife Sanctuary is located in which district?
new.x: Koundinya WLS is in Chittoor district (not Nellore) and borders Tamil Nadu.

new.s: Coringa Wildlife Sanctuary, known for saltwater crocodiles, is in which district?
new.x: Coringa WLS lies in Kakinada district in the Godavari mangroves.

new.s: Which critically endangered herb was found in Gundla Brahmeswaram Wildlife Sanctuary in 2026?
new.x: Euphorbia chalamensis, a new critically endangered herb, was found in Gundla Brahmeswaram in 2026.

new.s: Kolleru was notified as a wildlife sanctuary in:
new.x: Kolleru became a WLS in 1999 and a Ramsar site in 2002.

new.s: Rollapadu and Sri Lankamalleswara wildlife sanctuaries were both notified in:
new.x: Both Rollapadu and Sri Lankamalleswara were notified in 1988.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Nagarjunasagar-Srisailam Tiger Reserve?
o: It was declared a tiger reserve in 1983
It spans Andhra Pradesh and Telangana
It is also a biosphere reserve
Rajiv Gandhi WLS forms its core
new.x: NSTR is not a biosphere reserve; AP's only biosphere reserve is Seshachalam.

new.s: The core of Nagarjunasagar-Srisailam Tiger Reserve in Andhra Pradesh lies in which districts?
new.x: NSTR's AP core lies in Nandyal, Prakasam and Palnadu in the Nallamala hills.

new.s: The Seshachalam Biosphere Reserve covers an area of about:
new.x: Seshachalam BR covers 4,755.997 sq km; 3,728 sq km is NSTR and 8,139.88 sq km the whole PA network.

new.s: Seshachalam Biosphere Reserve falls under which forest circles?
new.x: Seshachalam BR is under the Tirupati and Kurnool circles; Srisailam manages NSTR and Anantapuramu the Rayala Elephant Reserve.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Seshachalam Biosphere Reserve:
1. It was notified in 2010.
2. It is Andhra Pradesh's first and only biosphere reserve.
3. It lies in the Nallamala hills.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Seshachalam BR (2010) is AP's only BR and lies in the Seshachalam (Tirumala) hills, not the Nallamala.

new.s: The Rayala Elephant Reserve of Andhra Pradesh falls under which forest circle?
new.x: The elephant reserve (Koundinya WLS + Rayala ER) is under the Anantapuramu circle.

new.s: Elephants moved into the Palamaner-Koundinya area in which decade?
new.x: Elephants moved into Palamaner/Koundinya in the 1980s owing to drought in Hosur-Dharmapuri and Bannerghatta.

new.s: The golden gecko is found in which area of Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: The golden gecko is a species of the Tirumala hills in Sri Venkateswara NP.

new.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
new.x: Kanchu mekha belongs to Papikonda; Jerdon's courser is in Sri Lankamalleswara, GIB in Rollapadu and the saltwater crocodile in Coringa.

new.s: Which district of Andhra Pradesh has the largest forest area?
new.x: YSR Kadapa has the most forest area in AP and Krishna the least.

new.s: In 2023-24, Andhra Pradesh ranked ____ in India in fire-affected forest area.
new.x: AP was first in India in fire-affected forest area in 2023-24 (5,286.76 sq km).

new.s: The largest forest density class in Andhra Pradesh is:
new.x: Open Forest (14,363.50 sq km) is AP's largest forest density class.

new.s: Which hills mark the western extent of Andhra Pradesh's forests?
new.x: Balaghat hills mark the western extent; Simhachalam the northern and Palakonda-Nallamala the southern.

new.s: Telukunchi bird area is located in which district?
new.x: Telineelapuram and Telukunchi, with painted storks and pelicans, are in Srikakulam district.

new.s: Naupada, a coastal and marine biodiversity area, is in which district?
new.x: Naupada coastal and marine biodiversity area is in Srikakulam district.

new.s: The Ramsar area of Kolleru Lake is about:
new.x: Kolleru's Ramsar area is about 90,100 ha (~901 sq km), much larger than the 308.55 sq km sanctuary.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the wetlands of Andhra Pradesh:
1. Pulicat is a brackish lagoon.
2. Kolleru is a brackish lagoon.
3. The Buckingham Canal passes through Pulicat.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Pulicat is brackish and crossed by the Buckingham Canal; Kolleru is a freshwater lake.

new.s: Mrugavani National Park, often used as a distractor in AP questions, is in:
new.x: Mrugavani NP, like Kasu Brahmananda Reddy NP and Eturunagaram WLS, is in Telangana.

new.s: Chinnar Wildlife Sanctuary is located in:
new.x: Chinnar WLS is in Kerala, not in AP.

new.s: Deltaic alluvium covers about what share of Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: Deltaic alluvium covers ~6% of AP; 45.6% is alluvium's share of India.

new.s: How many soil categories does Andhra Pradesh have as per 2024-25 data?
new.x: AP has 22 soil categories, of which 10 predominate and cover over 88% of the State.

new.s: The largest soil category of AP, covering 20.42%, is:
o: Loamy to clayey skeletal deep reddish-brown soils
new.x: 'Loamy to clayey skeletal deep reddish-brown soils' cover 20.42%; calcareous black covers 9.57%.

new.s: Red soils with a clay base cover about what share of Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: Red soils with clay base cover 12%; red earths with loamy subsoil 30%, red loamy 9% and red sandy 8%.

new.s: Red sandy (chalka) soils cover about what share of Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: Red sandy (chalka) soils cover about 8% of AP, the smallest of the listed red sub-types.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the red soils of Andhra Pradesh:
1. They are poor in nitrogen and humus.
2. They are fairly rich in potash.
3. They have high moisture retention.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Red soils are poor in nitrogen and humus and fairly rich in potash, but have low moisture retention.

new.s: Black soils of Andhra Pradesh are rich in:
o: Hydrated iron and aluminium oxides only
new.x: Black soils are rich in calcium, potash and magnesium but poor in nitrogen, phosphorus and humus.

new.s: In Andhra Pradesh, 'Dubba' refers to:
new.x: Dubba denotes red loamy sands; Chalka is red sandy soil and Regur black cotton soil.

new.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
new.x: Bhangar is old alluvium; Khadar is new alluvium, Chalka is red sandy soil and Vertisols are black soils.

new.s: The Godavari delta alluvium lies mainly around:
new.x: The Godavari delta is around Rajahmundry and Kakinada; the Krishna delta around Vijayawada-Machilipatnam.

new.s: Which of the following is an elevated laterite area of Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: Satyavedu and Puttur are elevated laterite areas; Adoni, Tadipatri and Kunderu have black soils.

new.s: Laterite soils cover about what share of Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: Laterite is AP's smallest soil group at about 1%.

new.s: Groundnut and castor are mainly grown in Andhra Pradesh on:
new.x: Red soils suit groundnut, castor, millets and pulses such as red, green and horse gram.

new.s: Mango, cashew and tamarind in Andhra Pradesh are associated with which soil?
new.x: Laterite soils carry mango, cashew, tamarind, coconut and plantation crops.

new.s: Saline soils are mainly reclaimed by:
new.x: Saline soils are reclaimed by drainage and leaching; alkaline soils by gypsum.

new.s: How many watersheds in Andhra Pradesh were classed saline in 2025-26?
new.x: 39 watersheds covering 896 villages were classed saline in 2025-26.

new.s: Coastal erosion due to sea-level rise and waves is reported at which place in Kakinada district?
new.x: Uppada (Kakinada) faces coastal erosion; Peddapuram, Ellavaram and Kavali are laterite areas.

new.s: How many rainfed districts are covered under Rainfed Area Development in Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: Rainfed Area Development covers 9 districts: 8 of Rayalaseema plus Prakasam.

new.s: Podu, which strips topsoil, is practised in:
o: Alluri Sitharama Raju and Parvathipuram Manyam
new.x: Podu (shifting cultivation) strips topsoil in ASR and Parvathipuram Manyam districts.

new.s: How many Soil Health Cards had been issued in Andhra Pradesh by 30 January 2025?
new.x: AP had issued 1,51,61,346 Soil Health Cards (cumulative) by 30 January 2025; India has over 25 crore.

new.s: AP's School Soil Health Programme (2025-26) covers how many Kendriya Vidyalayas?
new.x: The programme covers 50 Kendriya Vidyalayas plus 10 State schools.

new.s: The ideal pH range of soil for common crops is:
new.x: Common crops do best at pH 6–7; below 7 is acidic and above 7 alkaline.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh's share of India's mica reserves is about:
new.x: AP holds about 40.5% (~41%) of India's mica reserves and 70.2% of production; Rajasthan is 2nd with 28%.

new.s: Which State has the largest limestone reserves in India?
new.x: Karnataka holds the largest limestone reserves (25–28%); Rajasthan leads production.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh ranks first in India in the production of which beach-sand mineral?
new.x: AP is first in India in monazite production.

new.s: In the older inventory, Andhra Pradesh's diamond resources were about:
new.x: AP had 18.23 lakh carats of India's 319.22 lakh carats of diamonds.

new.s: The Kurnool system of rocks yields mainly:
new.x: The Kurnool system gives glass sand and ornamental stone and no metallic minerals; barytes and uranium are Cuddapah.

new.s: The Cuddapah basin is about how old?
new.x: The Proterozoic Cuddapah basin, AP's oldest basin, is about 1.6 billion years old.

new.s: Which of the following rock system – mineral pairs is correctly matched?
new.x: Khondalites of the Eastern Ghats carry bauxite and graphite; Gondwana gives coal and Cuddapah barytes and uranium.

new.s: Wolframite in Andhra Pradesh is found at:
new.x: Wolframite occurs at Buruguwada (East Godavari); Kasipatnam has apatite and Agnigundala copper.

new.s: Copper, zinc and silver deposits of Agnigundala and Bondalamottu are in which region?
new.x: Agnigundala and Bondalamottu copper-zinc-silver deposits are in the Guntur region.

new.s: Mangampet, one of the world's largest barytes deposits, is in which district?
new.x: Mangampet barytes is in YSR Kadapa, which also holds uranium at Tummalapalle.

new.s: Mica was declared a minor mineral in:
new.x: Mica was declared a minor mineral in 2015.

new.s: The Swarnagiri (Jonnagiri) gold mine is in which mandal of Kurnool district?
new.x: Swarnagiri is in Tuggali mandal, Kurnool; Ramagiri is an old gold field of Anantapur.

new.s: The oldest gold field of India is:
new.x: Kolar in Karnataka is India's oldest gold field; Ramagiri and Jonnagiri are AP sites.

new.s: The Tummalapalle uranium mine and plant has been working since:
new.x: Tummalapalle (YSR Kadapa) mine and plant have worked since 2012, handling 3,000 t of ore a day.

new.s: In 2023 NGRI found rare earth elements in syenite rocks of which district?
new.x: NGRI found rare earth elements in the syenite rocks of Anantapur in 2023.

new.s: Pista Green stone of Andhra Pradesh comes from:
new.x: Pista Green is from YSR Kadapa; Srikakulam Blue from Srikakulam and Kashmir White from Visakhapatnam.

new.s: Under the MMDR Act, 1957, major minerals listed in the First Schedule are regulated by the:
new.x: Major minerals (First Schedule) are with the Centre; minor minerals such as sand and gravel with the States.

new.s: The Ravva shallow offshore field of the KG basin has been operated since 1996 by:
new.x: Ravva was discovered by ONGC in 1987 and has been operated by Cairn since 1996.

new.s: ONGC bought 80% and operatorship of the Deen Dayal West block from GSPC in:
new.x: ONGC took 80% and operatorship of GSPC's Deen Dayal West block (KG-OSN-2001/3) in 2017.

new.s: Which of the following KG-basin pairs is correctly matched?
new.x: KG-D6 is Reliance's deepwater discovery; Ravva is operated by Cairn, Tatipaka is ONGC and Deen Dayal West was GSPC's.

new.s: Which place is Andhra Pradesh's raw-salt hub?
new.x: Naupada (Srikakulam) is AP's raw-salt hub; Gujarat leads India with ~78% of salt.

new.s: The continental shelf of Andhra Pradesh is about:
new.x: AP's continental shelf is about 33,227 sq km.

new.s: Under Phase I, a new fishing harbour is being built at Juvvaladinne in which district?
new.x: Juvvaladinne (Nellore) and Uppada (East Godavari) are new Phase I harbours.

new.s: The forest cover of Andhra Pradesh, 30,084.96 sq km, forms what share of the State?
new.x: AP's forest cover is 30,084.96 sq km, about 23.59% of the State.

new.s: Which pair of river basins is important in northern Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: Vamsadhara and Nagavali are the basins of northern AP; Godavari, Krishna and Pennar are the major basins.
